slots.name: founding year
slots.sentence: Celeste Pizza is named after “Mama” Celeste Lizzio, who began cooking the popular pies at a restaurant she opened in Chicago in 1937 with her husband, Anthony, according to Reference.org.

slots.name: closure year
slots.sentence: The couple closed the restaurant in 1962 but continued selling their pizzas to other eateries.

slots.name: Quaker acquisition year
slots.sentence: When the Quaker Oats Co. acquired Celeste pizzas in 1969, it became one of the top-selling brands in the 1970s, with Lizzio being prominently featured in the brand's TV advertising.

slots.name: Conagra acquisition year
slots.sentence: Conagra Brands acquired Celeste pizzas in 2018, amid declining sales.

slots.name: death age
slots.sentence: Conagra's acquisition of the pizza brand came 30 years after Lizzio died of a heart condition in 1988 at age 80, according to Reference.org.
